words.text: Ah. I wondered when I'd be seeing you.
words.speaker: Mr Ollivander

words.text: Which is your wand arm? Hold out your hand.
words.speaker: Mr Ollivander

words.text: Curious... very curious. The wand chooses the wizard. It is not always clear why.
words.speaker: Mr Ollivander

words.text: I think we must expect great things from you.
words.speaker: Mr Ollivander
